name: Omnivox v1.16.1
body:
## Omnivox v1.16.1

Cross-platform Emacsvox/Emacspeak speech server.

### Changes

See the [project changelog](https://github.com/bartbunting/omnivox/blob/v1.16.1/CHANGELOG.md)
for the changes in this release.

### Installation

Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 amd64 users can download
`omnivox_1.16.1-1_amd64.deb`
and `sha256sums.txt`, verify the checksum, then install with:

```sh
sudo apt install ./omnivox_1.16.1-1_amd64.deb
```

The package contains the core server, matching eSpeak data, and the
RHVoice integration helper. Optional engines and user-supplied voices
remain separate. The matching `omnivox-1.16.1-piper-source.tar.gz`
includes the complete Omnivox tree, vendored Cargo dependencies, and
eSpeak NG/Sonic sources used by the core package as well as Piper.

Download one archive and `sha256sums.txt`. Verify the archive before
extraction; full Linux, macOS, and Windows commands are in the
[deployment guide](https://github.com/bartbunting/omnivox/blob/v1.16.1/.github/DEPLOYMENT.md).

After extracting on Linux or macOS:

```bash
binary_directory="$HOME/.local/bin"
adapter_directory="$HOME/.emacs.d/lisp/omnivox"
mkdir -p "$binary_directory/espeak-ng-data" \
  "$binary_directory/third-party-licenses" \
  "$binary_directory/rhvoice" "$adapter_directory"
install -m 755 omnivox "$binary_directory/omnivox"
install -m 644 omnivox-voices.el "$adapter_directory/omnivox-voices.el"
cp -R espeak-ng-data/. "$binary_directory/espeak-ng-data/"
cp -R third-party-licenses/. "$binary_directory/third-party-licenses/"
cp -R rhvoice/. "$binary_directory/rhvoice/"
```

After extracting on Windows:

```powershell
$destination = "$env:USERPROFILE\.emacspeak\servers"
$directories = @(
  $destination,
  "$destination\espeak-ng-data",
  "$destination\third-party-licenses",
  "$destination\rhvoice"
)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $directories | Out-Null
Copy-Item -Force omnivox.exe, omnivox-voices.el $destination
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force espeak-ng-data\* "$destination\espeak-ng-data"
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force third-party-licenses\* "$destination\third-party-licenses"
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force rhvoice\* "$destination\rhvoice"
```

`omnivox-voices.el` is the upstream Emacspeak adapter. Emacsvox uses
its own bundled adapter. See the project README for `init.el` setup.
`LICENSE` covers Omnivox-authored source; `LICENSING.md` explains
the separately licensed adapter and statically linked eSpeak NG
binary distribution.

### Binaries

| Platform | Architecture | File |
|----------|-------------|------|
| Linux | x64 (Ubuntu 24.04 ABI baseline) | `omnivox-1.16.1-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| macOS | Apple Silicon | `omnivox-1.16.1-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS | Intel | `omnivox-1.16.1-macos-x64.tar.gz` |
| Windows | x64 | `omnivox-1.16.1-windows-x64.zip` |
| Windows | ARM64 | `omnivox-1.16.1-windows-arm64.zip` |

Linux uses eSpeak NG. macOS uses AVSpeechSynthesizer, and Windows
uses WinRT SpeechSynthesizer. Every archive also contains the
eSpeak NG runtime data generated by the matching dependency build
and its third-party notices. This supports registered eSpeak
fallback on macOS and Windows.

Every generic archive also contains the portable RHVoice helper,
but not the RHVoice runtime, language data, or voices. Install a
compatible runtime separately as described in the RHVoice guide.

Windows archives also contain the 32-bit Eloquence and DECtalk
bridge helpers, their GPL notice, and exact source. They do not
contain ECI or DECtalk runtimes, dictionaries, or voices. A helper
becomes available only when the user supplies a compatible,
legitimately installed runtime.

The Linux archive requires Ubuntu 24.04-compatible glibc,
libstdc++, libgcc, and ALSA runtime libraries.

### Optional Piper companions

Piper is an optional out-of-process engine. Install the companion
matching the generic archive by extracting its top-level `piper/`
directory beside `omnivox` or `omnivox.exe`.

| Platform | Architecture | File |
|----------|-------------|------|
| Linux | x64 | `omnivox-1.16.1-piper-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| macOS | Apple Silicon | `omnivox-1.16.1-piper-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS | Intel | `omnivox-1.16.1-piper-macos-x64.tar.gz` |
| Windows | x64 | `omnivox-1.16.1-piper-windows-x64.zip` |

Voice models are user-supplied and are not included or endorsed by
this release. Review a model's `MODEL_CARD` before configuring it.
`omnivox-1.16.1-piper-source.tar.gz`
contains the exact corresponding source and locked build inputs for
all four companions.

### Optional Flite companions

Flite is a compact English out-of-process engine with only
`cmu_us_slt` compiled in. Extract the matching archive's top-level
`flite/` directory beside the generic executable. No system Flite
installation or separate voice download is required.

| Platform | Architecture | File |
|----------|-------------|------|
| Linux | x64 | `omnivox-1.16.1-flite-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| Linux | ARM64 | `omnivox-1.16.1-flite-linux-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS | Apple Silicon | `omnivox-1.16.1-flite-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS | Intel | `omnivox-1.16.1-flite-macos-x64.tar.gz` |
| Windows | x64 | `omnivox-1.16.1-flite-windows-x64.zip` |
| Windows | ARM64 | `omnivox-1.16.1-flite-windows-arm64.zip` |

Optional local `.flitevox` files remain user-supplied and retain
their own licences. The exact upstream Flite source and Omnivox
build integration are in
`omnivox-1.16.1-flite-source.tar.gz`.

### Optional RuTTS companions

RuTTS is a compact Russian out-of-process engine with built-in
`male` and `female` voices. Extract the matching archive's
top-level `rutts/` directory beside the generic executable. No
system RuTTS installation or separate voice download is required.

| Platform | Architecture | File |
|----------|-------------|------|
| Linux | x64 | `omnivox-1.16.1-rutts-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| Linux | ARM64 | `omnivox-1.16.1-rutts-linux-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS | Apple Silicon | `omnivox-1.16.1-rutts-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS | Intel | `omnivox-1.16.1-rutts-macos-x64.tar.gz` |
| Windows | x64 | `omnivox-1.16.1-rutts-windows-x64.zip` |
| Windows | ARM64 | `omnivox-1.16.1-rutts-windows-arm64.zip` |

This companion is built without RuLex. The exact upstream RuTTS
source and Omnivox build integration are in
`omnivox-1.16.1-rutts-source.tar.gz`.

### Experimental TGSpeechBox companion

TGSpeechBox is an opt-in formant engine published for Windows x64.
Extract the archive's top-level `tgspeechbox/` directory beside
the Windows x64 generic executable:

`omnivox-1.16.1-tgspeechbox-windows-x64.zip`

Its seven profiles and 22 languages are built from the exact
checksum-locked `v-310@f5ec247` upstream snapshot. Its measured
Adam `en-us` rate curve follows Eloquence until the native ceiling,
and exact requested anchors support progressive presentation
actions. The upstream beta and limited runtime-accepted platform
coverage keep the companion experimental. Its complete Omnivox,
TGSpeechBox, eSpeak NG, and Cargo source is in
`omnivox-1.16.1-tgspeechbox-source.tar.gz`.

These binaries are not code-signed or notarized, so Gatekeeper or
SmartScreen may warn. Verify `sha256sums.txt`; do not disable
platform protections globally.
